subject: prd/implement-now
statement: A post-cutover qualification-defect drill stops affected claims, invalidates every affected in-flight or unaccepted implementation artifact, preserves unaffected work, reruns replacement evidence on the exact affected task/proposal revision, and produces an operator remediation brief for already accepted artifacts without destructive rollback.
fit_criterion: defect-disposition drill record plus EVT-11 evidence, exact-revision replacement result, and accepted-artifact brief
